claims: You can text Hermes like a coworker; it works 24/7

Demo: '@Hermes Please upload these two invoices into my 2026 invoices TAX folder' -> agent reads CONTEXT.md, Open Loops.md, offload-mode.txt, searches files for tax, runs python3/terminal, copies both PDFs to C:\Users\Robert\Documents\2026 Invoices in ~2 min / 6 iterations
Can run on a VPS for ~$5/month instead of a Mac Mini; part 2 covers setup
how_to_steps: Install Hermes Agent locally or on a cheap VPS
Connect it to Slack (or another messaging channel)
Send a message with attachments and an instruction; it reads its context files, uses terminal/python tools, and reports back
Watch part 2 on his profile for setup
